acceptanceCriteria: A valid cache remains reusable without cloning records and rebuilding the complete derived index.
Record tampering and derived-index tampering are still rejected and rebuilt.
Existing query/index behavior and missing-filter short-circuit behavior remain unchanged.
Focused tests, workspace tests, and the declared cache benchmark pass.
goal: Validate cached knowledge indexes without cloning and rebuilding the full derived index on every cache hit.
intent: Complete the original knowledge architecture finding by reducing derived-cache validation cost while preserving source and record tamper detection.
outOfScope: archive source-digest semantics; query result semantics; Outcome delivery; repository-wide crate extraction; historical compatibility deletion; release script migration; version publication
